news.title: Sora 3 ships with native synchronized audio
news.excerpt: OpenAI's video model now generates dialogue, effects, and ambient sound matched to the visuals — the missing piece for production use.

news.title: Google Veo adds 4K cinematic output and camera control
news.excerpt: Vertex customers get higher-fidelity generations with director-level camera movement — our testing shows it rivaling Sora shot-for-shot.

news.title: DeepSeek open-weights hit #1 on reasoning benchmarks at ~5% of the cost
news.excerpt: The open-source model family keeps closing the gap with closed frontier models — self-hosters are the big winners.

news.title: Cursor expands multi-file agent mode for production codebases
news.excerpt: The agentic editor now plans and executes larger cross-file changes with fewer stale-context errors.

news.title: Cline proves open-source coding agents are production-ready
news.excerpt: The free VS Code agent plans, edits, runs, and self-corrects — with any model you connect.

news.title: Flux vs Midjourney: the photorealism gap has officially closed
news.excerpt: Our 200-image benchmark shows Flux matching or beating Midjourney on realism and text rendering.

news.title: Gamma makes AI-generated decks the default for busy teams
news.excerpt: Prompt-to-presentation in minutes — we built 15 real decks to find where it still falls short.

news.title: Kling AI doubles down on pricing pressure in AI video
news.excerpt: Kuaishou's generator pairs near-top-tier quality with the most generous free credits in the category.

news.title: Replit Agent: from prompt to deployed app in an afternoon
news.excerpt: We built three real apps in three weeks — here's where autonomous building shines and where it breaks.

news.title: Grok's real-time X integration becomes its competitive moat
news.excerpt: Live social awareness lets Grok catch sentiment shifts hours before manual monitoring — for better and worse.
